body: A separate read-only reviewer compared dirty story-100 to the actual independently signed acceptance/bindings. Findings are provisional, not an exact-SHA verdict: no early bootstrap so blocked setup can exceed queue ceiling; final shell timestamp check is not atomic admission ACK; SLOT_HELD exec skips target-sensitive nesting; helper:38,57-62 excludes by basename instead of helper/service identity; result:179-194 lacks invocation identity; retry hashes unresolved target/toolchain and defaults bench to dev. No files/processes changed. Useful bounded history/redaction/predecessor work preserved. Recommend coordinating into one lane retaining reviewed bootstrap protocol, then exact-head independent review; our tested module primitives exist but wrapper integration is not claimed complete. Owner response still needed. Root's pending question offers combined-batch ownership or foreign-lane delivery+reviewed integration; no branch deletion/reset planned.
subject: STORY-100 provisional findings against binding design
